significance: A Vaishnava temple in the Tallakulam quarter of Madurai, credited to the Nayak ruler Thirumalai Nayak and administered within the Kallalagar temple establishment. Its Venkatachalapathy is unusual in facing south.
story: The king is said to have come upon an angry image of Hanuman while hunting for a broken bell, and then to have received a vision of Venkatachalapathy that prompted him to raise the temple.
